# ZeroC.LMDB

This package provides the [LMDB] static libraries for both debug and release builds.

## Source

LMDB is used unmodified. The MSBuild project, nuspec and targets used to produce this package are available on
GitHub, alongside the source URL and checksum for the upstream release the libraries were built from:

👉 https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/tree/main/packaging/third-party/windows

[LMDB]: https://www.symas.com/mdb/
